name: Amanat Fund
summary: Welfare committee ledger: zakat, sadqa and fitrana funds, ration families, open spending report
about: A transparent money desk for a masjid or neighbourhood welfare committee, in PKR. It records donations into separate zakat, sadqa, fitrana and general funds, tracks monthly ration packs for families, includes a zakat calculator at 2.5% with a nisab check, and shows exactly where every rupee went. Good for a mohalla committee, a small trust or a school charity.
how: The four fund jars fill up on the Overview; hover the money river to see how much of each fund went to rations, medical help or bills.
Press Donation to record money in. Choose Fitrana and enter the household size to get the amount, then print the receipt.
On Families, press Mark delivered when a ration pack reaches a family, or deliver to all remaining in one go.
Open the Zakat calculator, enter cash, gold, stock and debts: the nisab bar and the 2.5% amount update as you type.
Record spending from a fund. The form refuses what that fund can't pay for, such as zakat for masjid upkeep.
The Spending report shows the river for this month or three months, a full list with bills, a CSV download and a printable summary.
